## What does this PR do?

The table and list use the `mcp__<server>__<tool>` form.

Found by a docs-drift pass comparing pages with the code on current main.

## Related Issue

Fixes #125129

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] 🔒 Security fix
- [x] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ✅ Tests (adding or improving test coverage)
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] 🎯 New skill (bundled or hub)

## Changes Made

- `user-guide/features/mcp.md` and its zh-Hans mirror.
- e664c2c30d (review follow-up): the unreal-mcp skill and its two references, the qmd skill, both generated skill pages (regenerated with `website/scripts/generate-skill-docs.py`, no drift), `guides/use-mcp-with-hermes.md`, and the zh-Hans qmd and use-mcp pages now use `mcp__<server>__<tool>`.
- Docs: This PR is the docs change.

## How to Test

Docs only. `python3 website/scripts/check_doc_links.py`: OK.
